name: Shatter battle transition
oneLiner: When a battle starts, the current frame is captured, cracks from the point of contact and breaks into shards that spin and fall (or swirls, pixelates or irises closed); the game switches scenes at the midpoint under full cover, and the new scene is revealed. Input waits until it ends.
fits: turn-based RPG with random or touch encounters
any game with a title-to-play or map-to-battle switch
notFor: games where the world must keep running during a scene change (online play, real-time competitive)
seamless battles fought on the map itself (nothing to switch to)
very frequent switches (every few seconds) where a 1 s cover becomes tiring: use reveal 'cut' and a short duration, or none

needs: scene switch: the place where the game enters (and optionally leaves) a battle or starts a wave
a way to draw the current frame on demand (or the screen canvas) for the capture
fixed-step clock in ms, called every step, also while the transition runs
the last draw of every frame (after scene, HUD and dialogs), live loop and freeze path
optional: focus point (player or touched enemy) in screen pixels
provides: busy flag: input and world logic wait while true
mid-point callback (screen fully covered) to switch scenes

params.label: Leave effect (battle to map, next wave)

assets: module/battle-transition.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_BattleTransition): capture, shard geometry and bevels, cracks, dust, swirl, mosaic, iris, timeline and callbacks; colours through GameDNA_Skin with a built-in pixel16 fallback
